about: Arya Mahila Post Graduate College was founded in 1956 and is managed by Shri Arya Mahila Hitakarini Mahaparishad, established by the efforts of Smt. Vidya Devi Ji, a disciple of Shri Gyananand Maharaj Ji. Situated in the heart of Kashi at Chetganj, the college has been admitted to the privileges of Banaras Hindu University since its inception and is an all-women college. According to its official website, NAAC conferred 'A' grade to the college in the academic session 2012-2013. Admission is obtained through the UET and PET entrance examinations conducted by Banaras Hindu University.
